kCAFG_appease_cultural_tensions = {
	court_position_types = { cultural_emissary_court_position }

	# Monthly cost for the task
	cost = {
		round = no
		gold = {
			add = {
				value = monthly_court_position_task_cost
				multiply = 3
				desc = COURT_POSITION_TASK_COST_BREAKDOWN_BASE
				format = "BASE_VALUE_FORMAT_DECIMALS_PLUS_NEGATIVE"
			}
		}
	}

	is_shown = {
		is_landed_or_landless_administrative = yes
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
        custom_tooltip = {
			text = kCAFG_appease_cultural_tensions_has_any_valid_province_tt
			scope:liege = {
				any_realm_province = {
					has_variable = kCAFG_culture_tension
					var:kCAFG_culture_tension >= 0.01
				}
			}
        }
	}

	on_start = {
		custom_tooltip = kCAFG_appease_cultural_tensions_tt
	}

	on_monthly = {
		random = {
			chance = {
				value = 17
				add = {
					value = "aptitude(cultural_emissary_court_position)"
					multiply = 3
				}
			}
			scope:liege = {
				random_realm_province = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = kCAFG_culture_tension
						var:kCAFG_culture_tension >= 0.01
					}

					weight = {
						base = 20
						modifier = {
							add = {
								value = var:kCAFG_culture_tension
								multiply = 200

								if = {
									limit = {
										barony = {
											exists = holder
											holder = scope:liege
										}
									}
									add = 15
									multiply = 2
								}
							}
						}
					}

					save_scope_as = affected_province
				}
				send_interface_toast = {
					type = event_royal_court_good_with_text
					title = kCAFG_appease_cultural_tensions_notification_title
					desc = kCAFG_appease_cultural_tensions_notification_desc
					left_icon = root
                    
                    scope:affected_province = {
                        custom_tooltip = {
                            text = kCAFG_appease_cultural_tensions_effect_tt
                            change_variable = {
                                name = kCAFG_culture_tension
                                subtract = V_kCAFG_appease_cultural_tensions_decrease
                            }
                            E_kCAFG_on_province_culture_tension_updated = yes
                        }
                    }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = ai_compassion
	}
}
